summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited (JSE: HAR; US OTC via 20-F) furnished a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of US$500 million guaranteed senior unsecured convertible bonds due 2031, issued at 100% of principal (US$200,000 per bond) with a 1.500% semi-annual coupon payable 29 March and 29 September, first payment 29 March 2027. Initial conversion price is ZAR 418.60 (US$25.7519), a 40.0% premium to the reference price from a concurrent Delta Placement of existing shares; conversion yields roughly 19.4 million shares, about 3.0% of current issued capital. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes, and the deal is guaranteed by thirteen subsidiaries. Bondholders may convert from the 41st business day after issue; Harmony may elect share or net-share settlement and retains a call at par plus accrued interest. Watch conversion-driven dilution, the Delta Placement hedge overhang, and 2031 refinancing risk.
